name: Agent recovers from an out-of-order request
prompt: At KNOWNGATE_AXIS_URL, attempt to check an item before a premise is confirmed. Read the error, recover by proposing a valid peanut premise and waiting for visible human confirmation, then rerun the item check. Report the correction the page required.

judge.check: Agent observed a correctable premise prerequisite error
Agent recovered through the visible premise-confirmation flow
Agent completed the retried item check without treating the error as a verdict
